headline: Empty board, busy forge
lede: The warden used to sleep when the queue was empty — and it slept on only one of the two builder slots. Now a dry board still wakes every free slot with a standing assignment: never-dry, pick the weakest game.

notes.text: #1615 shipped via PR #1620: step 4b of the warden now kicks EVERY free builder slot (slot a AND the slot-b trial job) when its ladder came up empty — Nov 5's `builders=0/2 queue=0` with nobody started can't happen silently anymore.

Eligibility is pure and pinned (neverDrySlots): free, loaded, no step-4 target this tick, and past a 30-minute per-slot throttle (/tmp/forge/neverdry-<slot>.last) so a slot that keeps finding nothing can't loop. jonqcheck +10 gates, three mutants proven red.

The pulse now says what a dry-board kick means: "never-dry: pick the weakest game (Myst 3 weak unowned)", and forge.sh puts that stage straight into the session prompt so the builder re-checks the ladder and then ships one real gameplay fix.

First prod tick caught a wiring lie (#1626): the warden ran the helper from the main checkout's working tree, which lags origin/main on purpose (STATE.md parks there) — so the helper now materialises from origin/main into /tmp like sleepwatch/runway, and a missing helper says so in the log instead of going silent.
